name: Insurance broker pipeline
summary: Two pipelines for an insurance broker: new business from lead to bound with the advice documented before the offer, and a renewal case for every policy that starts 120 to 45 days before expiry.
description: Run new business and renewals side by side: opportunities from the first inquiry through needs analysis, quotes, offer and decision to a bound policy, an advice-documented date on every offer, and policies with their renewal date that open a renewal case on their own. It holds a reference to the advice record and to the policy in your agency system, never health data, claims details, bank details or identity copies. It is not policy administration, a comparison or rating engine, claims handling or commission reconciliation.

prompt.intro: Set up an insurance broker pipeline in my Customermates workspace: new business from lead to bound with the advice documented before the offer, policies with a renewal date and a renewal case for each, and dated follow-ups. Store no health data, claims details or identity copies.
questions: Which lines do you place, and do you serve commercial clients, private clients or both?
How long before expiry do you start a renewal, and how long is the usual notice period?
Where do you keep the advice record and the policy data? Only links are kept here.
Which country do you work in, and which advice duties apply to you?
